definitions.short: Nemuel , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H5241. Nemuel נְמוּאֵל proper name, masculine (compare Gray Prop. N. 307 ); — 1 son of Simeon Num 26:12 ; 1Chr 4:24 (= יְמוּאֵל , q. v., Gen 46:10 ; Exod 6:15 ), ᵐ5 Ναμουηλ . 2 a Reubenite (brother of Dathan and Abiram) Num 26:9 , ᵐ5 id.

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah when they rebelled against Yahweh;
The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;
The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
